classified_object.notes: Must separate training simulation, online network flying, and skill contests.

performance_agency.summary: Piloting skill can determine contest outcomes in race formats.

performance_interface.summary: Typically HOTAS/controller; motion rigs optional and uncommon as requirement.

embodied_performance.summary: Typically HOTAS/controller; motion rigs optional and uncommon as requirement. Migrated as Embodied Performance; demand types are provisional.

arena.summary: Computational airspace/course is the contest arena.

distributed_arena_relation.synchronization_mechanism: Simulator or network state can be shared computationally.
distributed_arena_relation.calibration_equivalence: Hardware and software variance remain material.
distributed_arena_relation.officiation_relation: Publisher, software, or community administration varies by contest.
distributed_arena_relation.safety_relation: Physical consequences are limited; local setup and fatigue remain relevant.

sensing_tracking.summary: Simulator state is authoritative for the contest.

measurement.summary: Race times/scores in contest modes; variance across setups.

comparability.summary: Hardware/software variance often large and weakly controlled.

officiation.summary: Contest admins or automatic scoring depending on event.

outcome_openness.summary: Skill contests can be open; training flights need not be contests.

consequence_structure.summary: Prizes/reputation in contests; often low outside promotional events.

operational_spatial_integration.summary: Computational arena operational for contests; athletic embodiment typically weak.

source_provisional_finding.summary: Function before imagery: simulation/contest hybrid with weak athletic embodiment and governance.

content: Federation-governed championship with athletic-performance claims, comparability protocol, and embodied interface requirements.

evidence_sources.source_title: Reno Air Racing Series / Microsoft Reno Air Racing Contest rules

record.provenance_note: Per-field claim_class and status preserved verbatim from the source case. source_provisional_finding is the corpus's own attributed reading, not a new Atlas verdict. Provider claims live in evidence_sources; Altis interpretation carries C4/C5.
